verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own docs show schema-driven structured extraction: `page.extract` takes a JSON schema, `page.agent.run_task` accepts a `data_extraction_schema`, and tasks can take an optional JSON schema for structured output. Nothing in the pack shows the output is actually validated against that schema, or that native Zod/Pydantic models are supported rather than raw JSON Schema. Missing for 10: documented schema validation and error handling on extracted output, native Zod/Pydantic type integration in the SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract typed, schema-validated data (Zod/Pydantic-style) from pages the agent visits, not just raw text

citations.quote: you can extract structured data from any page using `page.extract` with a JSON schema, or by passing a `data_extraction_schema` to `page.agent.run_task`
optionally a JSON schema for structured output
page.extract(prompt, schema) Extract structured data with optional JSON schema
